raw_response:
I farm a lot of land now, 379.9 mu, so I cannot do everything by hand like a very small household. But I still think in the old way: what worked on my own fields, what I saw nearby, and what I can afford without getting stuck. This year I will still keep cotton as the main crop, because that is what this land is set up for and I know how to manage it. Cotton takes more watching, but if I leave too much of it, I also worry about price and picking labor, so I will keep one part in maize. Maize is easier, faster, and gives me some steady grain and cash. For cotton, I will not be stingy with base fertilizer, because if cotton starts weak it stays weak. For maize, I will do it simpler, one base dressing and one topdressing, same as the bigger farmers around here. I have well water, so if the rain misses, I can still save the crop, but pumping costs money, so I only water at the key times.
